description: Review stored and saved LinkedIn posts, compare post performance and audience history, and create or edit private AuthoredUp text drafts with formatting and tags. An AuthoredUp account with an active license and connected LinkedIn profile is required for account data and drafts. Audience metrics may be estimated or unavailable. This integration does not publish to LinkedIn, edit published posts, or attach media. Planned draft times are organizational metadata and do not schedule publication.
